d:
Welcome to the weird and wonderful world of animal alliances, where friends are a force with which to be reckoned. Life has developed an array of unseen abilities to communicate and cooperate - glowing squirrels, snake-imitating owls and even enormous trees are among those that collaborate to find food, escape their enemies and produce the next generation. Featuring narration from Benedict Cumberbatch.
Super/Natural | S1 E1 "Strange Relations"
